tools.name: shell_list
tools.description_prefix: List background shell sessions (running and recently finished), showing each session's ID, a short command preview, status, and start time. Long commands are truncated.

tools.name: shell_tail
tools.description_prefix: Read output from a shell session. Returns the last 10 lines by default. Use start_line or byte_offset to page through large outputs, pattern to filter lines, and max_bytes to cap response size.

tools.name: shell_status
tools.description_prefix: Check whether a background shell session is still running, has exited, or has expired. Returns the session's current status and exit code if finished.

tools.name: shell_kill
tools.description_prefix: Terminate a running shell session and clean up its resources. The session is removed from the active list.

tools.name: shell_send
tools.description_prefix: Write to the stdin of a running shell session. Useful for interactive processes that expect typed input (REPLs, prompts, etc.). Include a trailing newline (\n) to submit the input.
